run_camera_transfer: run the camera transfer CLI tool with robot IP, transfer executable, dataset name, and retry count
check_robot_connectivity: check if a robot at a given IP address is reachable by pinging it

refactor_check_robot_connectivity: refactor check_robot_connectivity to support custom timeout or additional connectivity checks beyond ping
